faq.q: How did Grandview condos and townhomes do in September 2026?
faq.a: The Grandview sub-area recorded 146 attached listings and 20 sales (14% sales ratio); at the S Surrey White Rock community level the condos & townhomes median sale price was $700,000 with a 99% sale-to-list ratio and 33 days on market (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: Which schools are in the Grandview Heights area?
faq.a: Edgewood Elementary (16666 23 Avenue), Sunnyside Elementary (2828 159 Street), Pacific Heights Elementary (17148 26 Avenue) and Grandview Heights Secondary (16987 25 Avenue) are physically in the area; SD36 catchment is set by exact address in the School Locator, and no catchment result is confirmed in this file.

faq.q: What recreation is at the corner itself?
faq.a: The Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre, 16855 24 Avenue — a City facility with a 10-lane 50-metre pool and a leisure pool — is in the sub-area beside Grandview Heights Secondary.

faq.q: What should I check before buying a strata home here?
faq.a: The strata's bylaws and rules, its Form B information certificate and its depreciation report (mandatory for stratas with five or more lots); strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.
